name: task-completion-gate
description: Set WBS tasks to in-progress at start, and require user review, acceptance verification, and final review before marking them complete.
notes: Use this when AI agents do not mark WBS tasks as [>] at task start, or mark tasks as [x] immediately after implementation work.
This feature keeps in-review or acceptance-pending tasks as [>].
E2E / device verification Runbook preparation is treated as part of implementation task work when applicable.
